metadata.title: ORCHID-Diagrams: calculated binary phase diagrams
metadata.description:
ORCHID-Diagrams: calculated binary phase diagrams: binary phase diagrams calculated with pycalphad 0.11.2 BinaryStrategy + equilibrium grid from the SGTE binary collection (Hallstedt 2025, CC BY 4.0), each tied to the exact TDB file by SHA-256 and to the original assessment it encodes (citation and DOI from the TDB header). Part of the ORCHID data release v2026.10. Short name in the paper: Diagrams.

What

  • 2,774 SGTE binary databases: 2,720 calculated, 54 failed (recorded with status failed).
  • Per diagram (phase-diagrams/sgte/<TDB>.json): phase-region boundaries, 15,322 distinct invariant equilibria (24,828 hits of the mapper, which finds an invariant from several starting points; the Parquet table has one row per distinct invariant) with temperatures, phases and phase compositions over all diagrams, an equilibrium phase grid, temperature range, TDB SHA-256, original-assessment citation and DOI.
  • phase-diagrams/index.json lists diagrams per system; Parquet tables phase_diagram_index and phase_diagram_invariants.

How

pycalphad 0.11.2 BinaryStrategy + equilibrium grid at 1 atm, run on every SGTE binary file of the ORCHID catalog (open-tdb).

Limitations

  • Calculated values are model results, not measurements, and are as good as the assessment and the calculation grid.
  • 54 files did not calculate; metastable and pressure-dependent features are not represented.

Licence

ORCHID's data are released under CC BY 4.0, as are the SGTE (B. Hallstedt, Calphad 89 (2025) 102833), Materials Project and OQMD data from which they are derived; attributions and statements of changes are in NOTICE.md, the licence of each folder in LICENSES.md (both in the bundle).

Files: one zip (orchid-phase-diagrams-v2026.10.zip) holding the files at their repository paths, a MANIFEST.sha256, the README, CHANGELOG and licence files. Its file list with sizes and SHA-256 is zenodo/phase-diagrams.files.json in the data repository.

How to cite

R. Arróyave, J. Saal, D. Shin, ORCHID-Diagrams: calculated binary phase diagrams (version 2026.10), Zenodo (2026). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-phase-diagrams

Part of: R. Arróyave, J. Saal, D. Shin, ORCHID data: umbrella record of the ORCHID datasets (version 2026.10; Version 1, machine-extracted), Zenodo (2026). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-orchid-data

Also cite B. Hallstedt, The SGTE collection of binary datasets, Calphad 89 (2025) 102833, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.calphad.2025.102833 (CC BY 4.0), and the original assessment named in each file.
